{"command":"create","path":"/app/test_layout_quine.sh","file_text":"#!/bin/bash

# Test script for LayoutQuine plugin

# Create test files
mkdir -p /tmp/layout_test
echo "Buffer 1 content" > /tmp/layout_test/buf1.txt
echo "Buffer 2 content" > /tmp/layout_test/buf2.txt
echo "Buffer 3 content" > /tmp/layout_test/buf3.txt
echo "Buffer 4 content" > /tmp/layout_test/buf4.txt

# Start Vim and create a test layout
# This will: create 2 tabs, with multiple windows in the second tab
# Tab 1: 1 window showing buf1.txt
# Tab 2: 2 windows (vsplit) showing buf2.txt and buf3.txt

vim -u NONE -U NONE \
    -c "edit /tmp/layout_test/buf1.txt" \
    -c "tabnew" \
    -c "edit /tmp/layout_test/buf2.txt" \
    -c "vsplit" \
    -c "edit /tmp/layout_test/buf3.txt" \
    -c "LayoutQuine /tmp/layout_test/generated_layout.vim" \
    -c "qa!" 2>&1

echo "=== Generated layout script ==="
cat /tmp/layout_test/generated_layout.vim

echo ""
echo "=== Testing the generated script ==="
# Test by running the generated script
vim -u NONE -U NONE \
    -c "source /tmp/layout_test/generated_layout.vim" \
    -c "echo 'Tabs: ' . tabpagenr('\$')" \
    -c "qa!" 2>&1
"}
